in_sanskrit.name: Messha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Messha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Messha is the Sanskrit name of the Hindu goddess Lakshmi, who is worshipped for wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower, a golden pot filled with gold coins, or a bowl of rice.
